//: Claude Sonnet 5.5 on the Anthropic API (ADR-0066): the shape of `anthropic-haiku.json` (that file says why a catalog provider). Sonnet 5.5 has no `off`. The `off` cell asks for `off`, jr2's own default. At pi-ai 1.4.0, Sonnet's `thinkingLevelMap.off` is null, and its `compat.supportsMidConvoEffort` is `true`. So the adapter sends adaptive thinking with effort `high`, and the Harness prints a `[thinking level]` line that says it sent effort `high` (ADR-0018). The `on` cell asks for `high` by name. So both cells run at `high`, and only `off` prints the line.
